issue.body:
I'm trying to make HEAD requests using the test client. It looks like the full response is being returned.
It seems to work as expected outside of tests (using `uvicorn`).

```python
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.responses import PlainTextResponse
from starlette.testclient import TestClient

app = Starlette()


@app.route('/', methods=['GET', 'HEAD'])
def homepage(request):
    return PlainTextResponse('Hello, world!')


def test_homepage_head():
    client = TestClient(app)

    response = client.head('/')

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.text == ''  # This fails, the full response is returned
```

Also, if I don't include `methods=['GET', 'HEAD']` it just returns a 405, checking previous issues, it sounds like HEAD should be included by default if GET is supported ? https://github.com/encode/starlette/issues/45 https://github.com/encode/starlette/issues/12
issue.title: HEAD method + test client
